name: panda-breath
title: Panda Breath
description: Drives a BIQU Panda Breath chamber-heating device as a standard Klipper heater. Adds a Klipper extra (panda_breath.py) that talks to the Panda Breath over its OEM WebSocket protocol, plus a [heater_generic] so you control chamber heat from the web UI and slicer like any other heater. Point it at your Panda Breath's host. The Panda Breath hardware is separate. Experimental: we have no Panda Breath to test against, so it is unproven on the real device.
tagline: Chamber heating with a BIQU Panda Breath, as a Klipper heater.
author: bespoked
